title: MCP tool layer (server.py) not exercised by an end-to-end transport test
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/server.py:23-82 registers 9 @mcp.tool() wrappers, but tests/ call SoccerService methods directly (tests/test_behaviors.py:8); no test drives the FastMCP stdio round-trip
suggestion: Add one smoke test that lists tools / invokes a tool via the MCP client to verify the transport wiring, not just the service

title: Overlapping CSVs are de-duplicated via a preferred-source-per-(season,competition) heuristic
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/service.py:30-36,59 selects the single source with the most rows per (season, competition group) so aggregates avoid double/triple counting; test_standings asserts max played<=38 (tests/test_behaviors.py:52); _factual.json score=1.0
suggestion: Working as intended; note that matches present only in a non-preferred source for a season are excluded from aggregates by design

title: BR-Football-Dataset season is inferred from match date year
evidence: brazilian_soccer_mcp/repository.py:98 passes season=None so _make_match falls back to match_date.year (repository.py:65); the extended dataset has no season column
suggestion: Acceptable; document that extended-dataset season == calendar year of the match date
